prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: HKUST Passport LANDMARK ink stamp, stamp-hkust.png.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
Input images: Image1 is the REQUIRED style-sheet A; match its clean hand-inked storybook feeling. Image2 is an approved Passport stamp, STAMP MEDIUM AND ROUND FRAMING reference only: one-colour ink, slightly imperfect stamped edge, simple shapes. Do not copy its clock tower, skyline, palms or composition. Image3 is the verified official HKUST Piazza reference from art PR99: use ONLY the curved academic building visible BEHIND the red sculpture. Image4 is the HKUST aerial campus photograph: use its identifiable concave academic frontage wrapping the Entrance Piazza, in the lower centre of that photo. Do not copy any photo texture, composition, sky, sea, words or logo.
PRIMARY MOTIF: HKUST's original curved academic building embracing the open Piazza at the CLEAR WATER BAY campus. A wide, gently concave semicircular modern academic facade, both side wings wrapping toward the viewer around an open rounded forecourt. About four storeys expressed by clean continuous horizontal bands and a few regular bold rectangular window marks following the curve, with the central atrium entrance visible as a simple dark rectangular opening. Simplify from the actual aerial reference while keeping its broad shallow concave wrap and stepped square end blocks. A slightly elevated front three-quarter view makes the curved building and open forecourt legible. The curve of the academic building is the unmistakable focal silhouette, not a generic straight office block, sports stadium, colosseum, horseshoe logo or the separate oval Shaw Auditorium.
STAMP DESIGN: round single ring border, slightly imperfect ink edges; the building composition fills the circle without touching the border, with a few simple curved paving lines suggesting the Piazza below it. Generous transparent negative space, restrained worn ink texture. One ink colour ONLY: ink blue #2F5D8A / RGB(47,93,138). All other pixels and negative spaces transparent. The specific monochrome stamp rule supersedes the generic multi-colour fills/shading in the style block. No 3D colour rendering or filled white disc. Bold enough to read at40px,64px,120px; avoid dense fine window grids or tiny detail.
Output one 1024x1024 square RGBA transparent stamp with transparent corners and clear outer padding. NO lettering, no numbers, no signage, no emblem or logo. NO Red Bird, sundial, bird, flame, sculpture, coat of arms, wax seal, letter/envelope or event walking path. This is a place stamp about the CURVED ACADEMIC BUILDING, distinct from the Red Bird vessel and from the Xinyi hunt stamp. No extra icons, no watermark.
reference_notes: PR99's official HKUST Piazza photo confirms the original concave academic frontage; helicopter aerial confirms its wrap around the open Entrance Piazza at Clear Water Bay. Building only; no Red Bird sculpture, university emblem or lettering.
aerial_photo_credit: Hkust pao, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0; photographed by Martin per EXIF; used only to inspect architecture, no photographic content committed.
postprocess: normalize-stamps.py --only hkust: downscale native1254 square to1024, remap all visible ink to RGB47,93,138 and remove generated paper/white fill through alpha. Existing stamps untouched.
